place.name: Casa de Osambela
place.description: The Casa de Osambela, also known as the Casa de Oquendo, is a building built during the colonial era of Peru. It stands on the site of the old novitiate of the Dominican fathers, destroyed by the earthquake of 1746, and part of the garden, facing the Calle de la Veracruz (today Jirón Conde de Superunda) in the historic center of the city of Lima.
